descriptor.underlying_event: Will BTC trade above $100,000 at 16:00 UTC today?

policy.human_readable_rules: Max 4x, smaller when the tick-sensitivity test binds. The risk premium covers 10% of the hold-to-resolution floor value. CLOSE_ONLY in the final hour. Losing positions are liquidated at 5% maintenance + $1. Profit is never capped or force-closed. Before resolution, maintenance for losing positions ramps to 50%.
